decision: No supported third-party Apple Home Intercom send/target/acknowledgement API identified in the reviewed official documentation and public SDK interfaces. Original delivery remains unfulfilled. This is a bounded lack of evidence, not a universal theorem that no current/future path exists.
research_issue_acceptance: The original issue explicitly accepts a documented blocked status in place of target readback. Closure concerns feasibility only, not delivery.

public_sdk_scan.scope: Read-only SDK System/Library/Frameworks .h in Headers or public .swiftinterface in Modules, resolved-file deduplication. Excludes PrivateFrameworks, PrivateHeaders, .private.swiftinterface and .package.swiftinterface. No framework instantiated.

Bluetooth SDP assigned service-class number 0x1110 in user/kernel public headers, not an Apple Home Intercom send/receive contract.

shortcuts_boundary: The documented generic named-shortcut URL mechanism is not treated as proof of a reusable system Intercom action. No installed shortcut, recording, Home permission or actual recipient examined. Any owner-created workflow remains separately unproved and unimplemented.
permissions: Apple user documentation assigns Intercom membership/speaker/notification preferences to Home Settings. HomeKit app entitlement and microphone/Siri permissions alone do not demonstrate Apple Intercom send entitlement. No user/device settings inspected.
target_readback: Not performed; blocked. No sent/received/audio playback acknowledgement asserted.
existing_options: pyatv documentation reviewed only. AirPlay/media streaming and reverse-engineered control are not substituted for Apple Home Intercom semantics. No alternative audio transport designed, installed or run; separate explicit authorization still required.
